title: Final Energy Result
description: Essential Criteria: The final energy of the back-scattered photons must be correctly calculated as 29.7 MeV.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The conservation of energy equation must be correctly applied to relate the energies before and after the collision.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The conservation of momentum must be correctly applied to relate the momenta before and after the collision.

title: Approximation Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The justification for approximations made in the calculations should be clearly stated.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units used in the calculations must be consistent and correctly converted where necessary.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect application of relativistic equations will result in a deduction.
